title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.30: Fixed a crash from BaseLib 3.4.x changing its block-modifier API (Method not found: ModifyBaseBlockAdditive) that caused multiplayer state divergence on turn 1 and could crash single-player on Tuned block cards. Tuned's block bonus no longer touches the deprecated BaseLib method.
